dataset: Already exposed CHECK = original CAL1; no independent calibration/holdout claim
scope: Seven of ten frozen-pool/refit FP with positive S and positive C. Other three rho=0,S<0,C=0 FP excluded as previously analyzed additive-score cases. No DEV outcome analysis in this report.
truth_use: A_target and X_true read only after explicit user authorization for mechanism diagnosis; diagnostic outputs only, never features, fitting, selection or thresholds.

zero_rho_counterexample.interpretation: rho=0 does not imply false identity; a hard rho>0 rule can remove real identities.

truth_and_signal_checks.global_scalar_handling: Saved X_true already reconstructs b with A_target; do not apply scientific.global_scalar again.

definitions.positive_mass: max(Delta,0), without changing saved C/tau; concentration denominator is sum positive mass, not net S
definitions.coefficient_replacement: Deleted minus full coefficient in the same existing leave-one-block training fit; molecular sum of aliases. Not a new pairwise or final pixel refit.
definitions.fixed_prediction_decomposition: For d=A_held(x_deleted-x_full), r_m=sum_j(A_target_j-A_nominal_j)X_true_mean_j, e_store=b-A_target X_true_mean: Delta_observed=Delta_nominal_fixed_predictions-2*r_m dot d-2*e_store dot d. Saved coefficients stay fixed.
definitions.causal_limit: Nominal-target arithmetic is NOT an unperturbed re-fit. Coefficients were learned from perturbed observation; small explicit mismatch cross-terms do not establish mismatch is unimportant or not causal. Closest spectra and replacement candidates are correlates, not certified donors.
definitions.block_limit: 34 physical closures are not independent replicates; equal block counts do not mean equal spectral energy or independent identity evidence.

direct_mismatch_projection.definition: a_g dot sum_j[(A_target_j-A_nominal_j)*X_true_mean_j] / ||a_g||^2; signed geometric projection, not an NNLS coefficient or proven donor allocation
